cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You can borrow the dress for ten pounds and an acknowledgment that you mocked it. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Money covers fabric. It doesn't cover wearing my bad taste proudly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now say which part of my judgement improved since yesterday.

mechanism: A manages lending a dress with a money charge and an escalating demand for public respect, adjusting payment while preserving the emotional price.
confusable: Generic wounded pride lacks repeated pricing of the same offer in practical and emotional terms.
comparison: Lift alternative concerns contact initiative; dress alternative escalates from private retraction to visible credit for taste.
seedUse: Dress seed supplies ten pounds and prior mockery; S02 should show a real concession to keep the borrower engaged as emotional terms grow.
